ui.title: Game Corner
ui.intro: Take a quick break, beat your best, and enjoy quick games made for mobile.
ui.categoriesLine: Puzzles · Arcade · Classics · 50 ways to take a break
ui.pageIntro: Pick a game, beat your best, and play a quick round.

2048.description: Slide matching tiles together to grow your score.
2048.prompt: Use arrow buttons, keyboard arrows, or swipe the board.

guess.name: Number Guess
guess.description: Find the secret number from 1 to 100.
guess.prompt: Guess the hidden number from 1 to 100.

rps.name: Rock Paper Scissors
rps.description: Choose a move and beat the computer.

dice.name: Dice Roll
dice.description: Roll the dice and chase your best result.

ttt.name: Tic Tac Toe
ttt.description: Get three marks in a row. Two players take turns.

memory.name: Memory Match
memory.description: Flip cards and find all six matching pairs.
memory.prompt: Tap two cards to find each matching pair.

color.name: Color Guess
color.description: Pick the swatch that matches the target color.
color.prompt: Tap the color swatch that matches the target.

math.name: Math Quiz
math.description: Solve a quick addition, subtraction, or multiplication.

higher.name: Higher or Lower
higher.description: Guess if the next card number is higher or lower.
higher.prompt: Will the next card be higher or lower? Equal cards count as a miss.

coin.name: Coin Toss
coin.description: Call heads or tails before the coin lands.
coin.prompt: Pick a side, then flip the coin.

reaction.name: Reaction Test
reaction.description: Wait for green, then tap as quickly as you can.
reaction.prompt: Tap Start, wait for the card to turn green, then tap it.

click.name: Click Counter
click.description: Tap as often as possible before time runs out.
click.prompt: Tap the button as many times as you can in 10 seconds.

catch.name: Catch the Box
catch.description: Catch the moving target ten times.
catch.prompt: Catch the moving target ten times.

snake.name: Snake
snake.description: Guide the snake, eat food, and avoid the walls.
snake.prompt: Use the arrow buttons or swipe the board to guide the snake.

word.name: Word Scramble
word.description: Unscramble the letters to reveal the word.

tap.name: Quick Tap
tap.description: Tap as many times as you can in ten seconds.
tap.prompt: Tap as many times as possible before the 10-second timer ends.

simon.name: Simon Says
simon.description: Watch the color sequence and repeat it.
simon.prompt: Watch the flashing sequence, then repeat it in order.

wheel.name: Lucky Wheel
wheel.description: Spin the wheel and see where luck lands.
wheel.prompt: Spin for a little fun—no real rewards or money involved.

emoji.name: Guess the Emoji
emoji.description: Decode the emoji clue and enter the word.
emoji.prompt: Guess the word from the emoji clue.

target.name: Target Score
target.description: Roll points and try to hit the target exactly.
target.prompt: Roll points to reach the target.

mole.name: Whack-a-Mole
mole.description: Catch the pop-up mole before it ducks away.
mole.prompt: Tap the glowing mole. Catch as many as you can in 20 seconds.

lights.name: Lights Out
lights.description: Switch off every light with the fewest moves.
lights.prompt: Tap a light to switch it and its neighbors. Turn every light off.

mines.name: Mini Mines
mines.description: Reveal safe tiles and avoid the hidden mines.
mines.prompt: Reveal safe tiles. Switch Flag mode to mark the five hidden mines.

connect.name: Connect Four
connect.description: Connect four counters before your opponent.
connect.prompt: Two players · drop four counters in a row to win.

dots.name: Dots & Boxes
dots.description: Claim boxes by drawing the final side.
dots.prompt: Two players take turns drawing sides. Complete more boxes to win.

fifteen.name: Sliding 15
fifteen.description: Put the numbered tiles back in order.
fifteen.prompt: Slide tiles into order. Tap a tile beside the empty space.

golf.name: Mini Golf
golf.description: Pick your aim and power to sink the putt.
golf.prompt: Adjust your shot power and land close to the hole.

breakout.name: Breakout
breakout.description: Bounce the ball and clear every brick.
breakout.prompt: Clear the bricks. Move the paddle, then tap Launch.

pong.name: Pocket Pong
pong.description: Keep the ball in play with your paddle.
pong.prompt: Move your paddle to keep the ball in play.

dodger.name: Lane Dodger
dodger.description: Switch lanes and dodge the falling blocks.
dodger.prompt: Switch lanes to dodge the falling blocks.

clock.name: Stop the Clock
clock.description: Stop the timer as close to the target as you can.
clock.prompt: Stop the timer as close to the target as you can.

recall.name: Sequence Recall
recall.description: Remember a growing sequence of numbers.
recall.prompt: Remember the number sequence, then type it in order.

runner.name: Grid Runner
runner.description: Collect gems and avoid traps before your moves run out.
runner.prompt: Move across the grid, collect four gems and avoid traps.

maze.name: Maze Escape
maze.description: Find your way from the entrance to the exit.
maze.prompt: Find the exit at the bottom-right. Arrow buttons move one step.

typing.name: Typing Sprint
typing.description: Type the phrase accurately before the timer ends.
typing.prompt: Type the phrase accurately before the timer runs out.

wordsearch.name: Word Search
wordsearch.description: Find the hidden word in a letter grid.
wordsearch.prompt: Find the hidden words in the letter grid.

pattern.name: Pattern Pop
pattern.description: Repeat the glowing pattern in the right order.
pattern.prompt: Repeat the glowing squares in the same order.

odd.name: Odd One Out
odd.description: Spot the one symbol that does not belong.
odd.prompt: Tap the one symbol that is different.

beat.name: Tap the Beat
beat.description: Keep a steady rhythm for ten taps.
beat.prompt: Tap the button ten times with a steady one-second rhythm.

colorreflex.name: Color Reflex
colorreflex.description: Match the shown color before the next one appears.
colorreflex.prompt: Tap the color name that matches the color shown.

mathsprint.name: Math Sprint
mathsprint.description: Solve as many quick sums as you can in 30 seconds.
mathsprint.prompt: Solve as many sums as possible in 30 seconds.

prime.name: Prime Hunt
prime.description: Tap all prime numbers and avoid the decoys.
prime.prompt: Tap every prime number from 1 to 30. Avoid the decoys.

anagram.name: Anagram Race
anagram.description: Solve as many anagrams as you can before time runs out.
anagram.prompt: Solve as many anagrams as you can in 30 seconds.

mixer.name: Color Mixer
mixer.description: Mix the RGB sliders to match the target shade.
mixer.prompt: Adjust the red, green, and blue sliders to match the target shade.

tower.name: Tower Stack
tower.description: Drop each moving platform to build a tall tower.
tower.prompt: Tap Drop when the moving block lines up. Stack as high as you can.

balance.name: Balance Bar
balance.description: Keep the balance marker centered for 15 seconds.
balance.prompt: Keep your balance in the safe zone for 15 seconds.

meteor.name: Meteor Dodge
meteor.description: Dodge falling meteors by switching lanes.
meteor.prompt: Switch lanes and avoid the falling meteors.

fruit.name: Fruit Catcher
fruit.description: Move your basket to catch fruit and dodge bombs.
fruit.prompt: Move your basket to catch fruit and dodge bombs.

treasure.name: Treasure Hunt
treasure.description: Follow the hot and cold clues to find treasure.
treasure.prompt: Tap a tile. Hotter means closer to the hidden treasure.

daily.name: Daily Brain Teaser
daily.description: Crack today's number code in six guesses.
daily.prompt: Crack today's four-digit code. Digits may repeat. You have six guesses.
